---
title: "02 — Environmental product registry"
format: html
---

## Goal

Select and freeze provider/product/version contracts for each environmental family before acquisition.

## Candidate provider families

- Copernicus Marine;
- ERA5;
- GEBCO;
- additional products only when scientifically justified.

## Required metadata per product

- provider;
- product ID;
- dataset ID;
- product version;
- variable names and units;
- native spatial resolution;
- native temporal resolution;
- vertical levels where relevant;
- temporal coverage;
- spatial coverage;
- processing level;
- licence/terms;
- access endpoint;
- acquisition date;
- checksum policy.

## Selection criteria

1. ecological relevance;
2. temporal coverage of the HCS research programme;
3. spatial support for Peru and Chile;
4. native resolution appropriate for the intended processes;
5. continuity/version stability;
6. reproducible programmatic access;
7. transparent provenance and licensing.

## Rule

A newer or higher-resolution product is not automatically preferred if it shortens the historical record or produces inconsistent temporal support.

## Outputs

- updated `config/products.yml`;
- populated `catalog/products.csv`;
- provider/version rationale;
- `GO / REVIEW / STOP` per environmental family.

## Current status

**REVIEW — provider families listed; exact product IDs not yet frozen.**
